ci_transport_observations.note: Three response writes encountered closed client connections at zone-0; the server continued and all windows completed with exact reference agreement.

original_local_failure.cause: Zone-2 process exited on Windows PermissionError WinError 5 during atomic state replacement
original_local_failure.resolution: Retry Windows replacement errors 5/32/33 up to 21 attempts with 50ms intervals; never acknowledge before persistence; permanent error preserves previous committed state

scope: Single-host independent-process HTTP replays of archived measured 5G observations. No fresh acquisition or multi-host latency measurement.
metric_note: Exact agreement is computational correctness, not attack-detection recall. Previous central-detector recall and FPR do not transfer to zonal topology.
limitations: No automatic leader election or coordinator redundancy
